description: Royal currency, vault treasures, and kingdom downfall cinematics for each realm

royal_currency.description: Kingdom-specific high-value currency found in vaults and major quests

kingdoms.name: Everdawn Plains
kingdoms.vault_location: Tutorial zone has no vault (starter area)
kingdoms.vault_loot: N/A - this is the spawn/safe zone

cutscene.trigger: First time entering from character creation
scenes: Hero awakens in peaceful flatlands
Healing tree circles glow softly
Two paths appear: left to safety, right to trials
Narrator: 'Your journey to Gather the Crown begins here.'

kingdoms.downfall_story: N/A - Everdawn Plains remains untouched as the starting sanctuary

kingdoms.name: Sylvara
kingdoms.vault_location: Beneath the Rootspire, deep underground chamber

cutscene.trigger: First approach to Sylvara kingdom gates
scenes: Flashback: Sylvara in its prime - lush forests, thriving villages, singing birds
Dark corruption spreads: vines turn black, trees wither
Shadow element seeps from underground, poisoning the roots
The Forest Guardian (boss) becomes corrupted, eyes glow purple
Present day: fog-covered ruins, twisted trees, eerie silence
Narrator: 'Once the greenest jewel of the realm, now choked by shadow. Can you restore the light?'

kingdoms.downfall_story: Corrupted by Shadow element - dark magic seeped into the roots, turning the guardian forest spirits against the people

kingdoms.name: Pyrrathia

royal_currency.name: Ember Crowns
royal_currency.appearance: Molten medallions that glow faintly red

kingdoms.vault_location: Deep within Molten Maw Caves, protected by lava flows

scenes: Flashback: Volcanic forges roaring, smiths crafting legendary weapons, prosperity
Volcanic eruption: mountains explode, lava floods the kingdom
Water element attack: massive tidal wave crashes into lava, creating deadly steam
The Infernal Titan (boss) rises from the chaos, half-molten, half-frozen
Present day: cracked obsidian ruins, rivers of cooling lava, ash-filled skies
Narrator: 'Fire met water in cataclysm. What remains is neither, but both - and neither will rest.'

kingdoms.downfall_story: Destroyed by opposing Water element - a massive flood from Tideholm crashed into the volcanic kingdom, creating a steam apocalypse

kingdoms.name: Frostvale
kingdoms.vault_location: Inside Glacier's Crown mountain, frozen throne room

scenes: Flashback: Ice castles gleaming, aurora borealis dancing, peaceful snow festivals
Eternal winter curse: blizzards never stop, temperatures drop beyond survival
Fire element corruption: volcanic fissures crack the ice, creating unstable terrain
The Glacier Colossus (boss) awakens, half-melting, enraged
Present day: shattered ice fields, frozen corpses, howling winds
Narrator: 'Frozen in time by its own element's excess. Fire tried to free it, but only brought ruin.'

kingdoms.downfall_story: Corrupted by its own Ice element (eternal winter curse) + Fire element attacks created unstable melting zones

kingdoms.name: Zerath Dunes
kingdoms.vault_location: Buried beneath the Sands of Silence, ancient pyramid

scenes: Flashback: Oasis cities, golden markets, caravans trading across dunes
Sandstorm apocalypse: massive storm buries entire cities in minutes
Water element drought: all oases dry up, rivers vanish
The Sandstorm Leviathan (boss) emerges, consuming everything
Present day: endless dunes, half-buried ruins, mirages of the past
Narrator: 'The sands remember prosperity. The sands remember betrayal. The sands remember everything.'

kingdoms.downfall_story: Destroyed by Water element drought (opposing force dried all water sources) + massive sandstorms buried the kingdom

kingdoms.name: Mor'gahl Fen
kingdoms.vault_location: Sunken palace in Bogheart Hollow, underwater chamber

scenes: Flashback: Wetland villages on stilts, alchemists brewing cures, harmony with nature
Poison outbreak: experimental alchemy goes wrong, toxic gas spreads
Light element purge attempt: holy magic burns the swamp, making it worse
The Bog Lurker (boss) mutates from the chaos, massive and toxic
Present day: rotting vegetation, poisonous mists, sunken ruins
Narrator: 'They sought to cure all ills. Instead, they became the disease.'

kingdoms.downfall_story: Self-inflicted Poison corruption (alchemical disaster) + Light element purge attempt backfired, creating toxic wasteland

kingdoms.name: Luminaris Caverns
kingdoms.vault_location: Heart of Shardspire Cavern, crystalline vault chamber

scenes: Flashback: Glowing crystal cities, scholars studying light magic, beauty beyond words
Shadow invasion: darkness seeps through cracks, corrupting crystals
Crystals shatter: the light becomes too intense, blinding and burning
The Crownshard Guardian (boss) fractures, becoming a prism of chaos
Present day: shattered crystals, blinding light zones, dangerous reflections
Narrator: 'Too much light casts the darkest shadows. Balance was forgotten.'

kingdoms.downfall_story: Corrupted by Shadow element invasion + Light element overload (crystals amplified light to destructive levels)

kingdoms.name: Crown Convergence
kingdoms.vault_location: The Shattered Vault - floating throne room at Crownspire peak

random_pool: Mythic creat eggs (any element, max stats)

cutscene.trigger: Unlocking Crown Convergence (after collecting all 7 kingdom crown fragments)
scenes: Flashback: The original Crown Kingdom - all elements in harmony, prosperity beyond measure
The Shattering: greed and power corrupt the rulers, elements turn against each other
Elemental war: fire vs water, light vs shadow, earth vs air - total chaos
The Crown shatters: fragments scatter across the realm, creating the 7 kingdoms
The Hollow Monarch (final boss) remains, wearing the broken crown, commanding all corrupted elements
Present day: fractured reality, floating islands, elemental storms colliding
Narrator: 'The Crown was whole. The Crown was broken. You will make it whole again... or join the ruins.'

kingdoms.downfall_story: Destroyed by ALL elements at once - the original kingdom's greed caused elemental civil war, shattering the crown and creating the 7 corrupted kingdoms

unlock_requirements: Obtain Vault Key from boss drop

vault_experience.entrance: Massive ornate doors with kingdom emblem
vault_experience.interior: Scrooge McDuck style - piles of coins, treasures glowing
vault_experience.interaction: Player can 'swim' through coins briefly (visual effect)
vault_experience.collection: Auto-collect all loot with dramatic fanfare

effect: NPCs return to towns and villages
